craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of containment — the Vijñānavāda opponent staged at full strength, then held; śāstra-hammer couplets, negation-anaphora, terminal doctrine words. First positive thesis; awareness lands last — the word the proof walked toward (pratiṣṭhā saṃvidāśrayā). Rejected: (a) consciousness for variety → killed: load terms stay uniform (ledger principle). (b) exclamation → killed: thesis is cold stone, not heat. Read aloud: BUT-ev-en-THERE, NO-work-ing IS-de-CLARED … SO their-GROUND STANDS-on a-WARE-ness.

lines: But even there, no working is declared of the already-proven thing —
the two run level. So their ground stands on awareness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpy arthakriyā siddhasattākārthe na varṇitā samam evānayos tena pratiṣṭhā saṃvidāśrayā

reads_against.argmap: Is function at least what we declare of already-proven things? → First positive thesis: standing (pratiṣṭhā) is awareness-grounded, since function presupposes what it should prove.
c1_essence: Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8).
Grasping-less awareness is declared inert, and the proof turns: only self-reflective consciousness can stand as ground (v9).
